name: We Are What We Eat: Perspectives on Food, Health and Society
description: The course will introduce students to the multiplicity of perspectives around food and food cultures and their implications for health and the environment. They will learn about social, economic, agroecological, political, and historical factors that have shaped diets in India and globally over the last few centuries. They will study theories of nutrition, nutrition transition, triple burden of malnutrition, and other theories on the relationship between food and health. The course will delve into the globalization of food cultures, sociology of food, economics and public policies around food and food security, changing agrarian environments and ecological implications of food choices.
